verdict.rationale: Fivetran is a managed data-movement and ELT platform, not an agent or tool-consuming AI client, so plugging third-party MCP servers into it for tool use is outside its product role. The pack shows Fivetran publishing its own MCP server and offering Connector SDK plugins for external coding agents. Both are the opposite direction (Fivetran's capabilities exposed to agents) and get no credit for an MCP-client story. Nothing shows the product itself consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
